questions.stemHtml: An 81-year-old man is brought to the orthopaedic emergency department with chief complaints of severe backache. As per the attendants, he fell at home while walking. There is localised tenderness over the L1 vertebra. Given below is the X-ray of the LS spine of this patient. Which statement is true regarding his underlying metabolic condition and associated pathology?

options.label: A
options.text: DEXA T score of -1.8 in this patient would confirm the diagnosis of osteoporosis

options.label: B
options.text: Kyphoplasty is the treatment of choice for him

options.label: C
options.text: The Serum mineralisation is usually normal

options.label: D
options.text: Vitamin D level of 20 ng/mL in this individual would confirm the diagnosis of osteoporosis
